items: Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Traits: A bundle of methods mixed into classes to share behaviour horizontally.
Constructor Property Promotion: Declaring constructor parameters as properties in a single step (PHP 8).
Named Arguments: Passing arguments by parameter name, in any order, for readable calls.
Property Hooks: Intercepting reads and writes of a property with hooked accessors.
Return Types: The declared type of a function's return value.

8214.title: Here is a version of the ShopProduct class with a calculateTax() method
8214.code:
<?php
class ShopProduct
{
    private int $taxrate = 20;

// ...

    public function calculateTax(float $price): float
    {
        return (($this->taxrate / 100) * $price);
    }
}

8216.code:

{

    public function calculateTax(float $price): float
    {
        return ( ( $this->taxrate / 100 ) * $price );
    }
}
